primary_recommendation.rationale: Provides the most balanced distribution (max/min ratio 2.63:1) while retaining 866 training sequences. Minimizes false-positive pull of high-frequency words during real-time sliding window inference.

alternative_recommendation.rationale: Alternative if higher data volume is desired for temporal regularization. Retains 1,039 training sequences with a 3.95:1 max/min ratio.
